capabilities.purpose: Pull structured data out of unstructured text or artifacts according to a caller-supplied schema.
capabilities.input_contract: { text: string (non-empty), schema: JSON Schema object }
capabilities.output_contract: Object conforming to the caller-supplied schema; track result carries meta.verification.
capabilities.validation: Tool output schema validation via step-output validation; schema argument is caller-owned so the capability stays domain-neutral.
capabilities.failure_behavior: TOOL_NOT_FOUND / INVALID_INPUT fail closed at plan-execution time; composed plans mark the track failed and abort by default.

capabilities.purpose: Assign one caller-defined category to a text payload from a caller-defined category set.
capabilities.output_contract: { category: string, confidence?: number, rationale?: string } per text.classify output schema.
capabilities.validation: Output validated against text.classify output schema; category is constrained to the caller's enum, so no domain taxonomy is baked in.
capabilities.failure_behavior: INVALID_INPUT when categories empty/missing; model/schema failures surface as STEP_SCHEMA_INVALID and abort the composed plan.
evidence: scripts/test-core01-system-formation.js (same track instance exercised by Repo Review input and Lighthouse-flavored findings input)

capabilities.purpose: Compress a text payload into a bounded structured summary.
capabilities.input_contract: { text: string (non-empty), style?: string, max_points?: integer }
capabilities.output_contract: { summary: string, key_points?: string[] } per text.summarize output schema.
capabilities.validation: Tool output schema validation at step level.
capabilities.failure_behavior: INVALID_INPUT on empty text; model failures abort the composed plan by default.

capabilities.purpose: Deterministically rank caller-provided items by weighted numeric score fields with optional limit and tie-break key.
capabilities.input_contract: { items: object[], score_fields: [{ field, weight? }], tie_break?: string, limit?: integer, ascending?: boolean }
capabilities.output_contract: { ranked: object[], strategy: 'deterministic_score_sum_v1', scores: object[] } aligned with input items.
capabilities.validation: Pure deterministic tool (no model); input validated by rank.items input schema, output by its output schema.
capabilities.failure_behavior: INVALID_INPUT on empty items or unknown score fields; deterministic first per project principle — no model call replaces ranking math.

capabilities.purpose: Validate any data object against a caller-supplied JSON Schema and report a structured verdict.
capabilities.input_contract: { data: any, schema: JSON Schema object }
capabilities.output_contract: { valid: boolean, errors: string[] } shaped as workflow-verification-result for gate use.
capabilities.validation: Deterministic: wraps companion/core/result-validator; usable as a track verification_step gate (STEP_VERIFICATION_FAILED when valid=false).
capabilities.failure_behavior: valid=false fails the verification gate cleanly; invalid tool input rejected with INVALID_INPUT before execution.

capabilities.purpose: Select the execution target for a step: provider, role-to-model resolution, qualification policy, and local-vs-relay placement.
capabilities.input_contract: Step executor role + options (resolveModelForRole, qualification policy, relay placement plan metadata).
capabilities.output_contract: Resolved model / provider / worker_used metadata recorded on each executed step (describeWorkerUsed).
capabilities.validation: worker_used metadata + relay placement provenance (planned vs actual target) captured in Track Run Records.
capabilities.failure_behavior: MODEL_UNAVAILABLE / PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE reported as structured warnings; relay fallback records fallbackReason.

capabilities.purpose: Rewrite or reshape a payload from one structure to another (e.g. findings to fix plans).
capabilities.input_contract: Domain-defined; no generic contract exists yet.
capabilities.validation: Existing per-track schema validation covers current domain uses.

capabilities.purpose: Assemble upstream artifacts into a consumer-facing deliverable (developer handoff, report, publish-ready document).
capabilities.input_contract: Assembled by composition entry input_map from any upstream track artifacts; export tool declares the artifact fields it requires, not a domain.
capabilities.output_contract: { title, sections[]/summary, markdown } deliverable per composing workflow's export track.
capabilities.validation: Export track output_schema validation; handoff documents carry meta.verification from the producing gates.
capabilities.failure_behavior: Missing required artifact fields fail with INVALID_INPUT; no silent empty exports.
